correctness.rationale: Independent networkx graph-isomorphism census of ALL 550 six-row multiset 6×6 0–1 incidence matrices with three ones per row/column yielded 540 connected semilabelled matrices and exactly five connected graph isomorphism classes (confirmed by House of Graphs). Exhaustive disjoint matching-endpoint domination search gives γpr values [4,4,4,4,6]; an edge dominates only six vertices so no order-12 graph has γpr=2. The unique γpr=6 class is independently isomorphic to the standard LCF [5,-5]^6 Franklin graph. Thus it alone meets Lu–Wu order-12 upper bound 6, all others equal4.

evidence: Lu–Wu universal theorem gives γpr≤2⌊n/4⌋, yielding ≤6 at n12, but says no Franklin and no twelve-vertex classification in full text.
The source lists K3,3 and Q3 as other-order equality witnesses; those do not dominate this exact order12 equality classification.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broad upper bound is logically weaker than exact equality classification; independence of 5-class census provides the added claim.
